title: NCCIA Adds BYD Atto 2 Electric Vehicles
excerpt: The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency has integrated new BYD Atto 2 electric cars into its fleet for operational use.
body_html:
The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) has expanded its fleet with the addition of new BYD Atto 2 electric vehicles.

According to the reports, these newly acquired electric cars are intended to support the agency's daily operational activities and duties.
